- .github/workflows/clarify.yml
  Line or code reference: 1029
  Problem: The Q_COUNT grep pattern `'^(>[[:space:]]*)*\*\*Q[0-9]+:'` lacks leading-whitespace tolerance before the optional blockquote prefix. The `^` anchor is immediately followed by `(>[[:space:]]*)*`, which requires `>` at column 0. An indented blockquoted question line such as `  > **Q1: text` will not match. The corresponding pattern in `plan.yml:1349` correctly uses `^\s*(?:>\s*)*`.
  Why it fails at runtime: If a Codex emission places blockquoted clarification output inside a nested markdown context (indented blockquote), Q_COUNT undercounts the questions, potentially triggering a false-negative "no questions detected" path when clarification was actually needed.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  Why it fails at runtime: Same undercount behavior as above, on the fallback Q_COUNT path that counts `Q<N>`-formatted lines after the `QUESTIONS:` header extraction.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml
  line 1029 and line 1075
  Problem: Both Q_COUNT greps anchor the blockquote group directly at column 0 with no leading whitespace tolerance:
  line 1029: `grep -cE '^(>[[:space:]]*)*\*\*Q[0-9]+:'`
  line 1075: `grep -cE '^(>[[:space:]]*)*\*?\*?Q[0-9]+'`
  The last commit on this branch (`2a26dc6` — "fix(clarify): allow leading indentation before blockquoted Q_COUNT lines") explicitly claims to add "optional leading whitespace before the optional blockquote prefix, mirroring the ^\s* anchor the plan.yml perl regexes already carry", but neither pattern contains a `[[:space:]]*` segment before the `(>[[:space:]]*)*` group. The `^` anchor therefore still requires the first character of the line to be either `>` or one of the `*` characters in the Q-ID, so an indented blockquoted line such as `  > **Q1: text` will not match.
  Why it fails at runtime: A Codex emission that puts the canonical blockquote inside a nested markdown context (indented list, indented code-comment block, etc.) will be undercounted by Q_COUNT. Because the downstream flow treats `Q_COUNT == 0` under a `STATUS: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION` status as "no questions", the workflow re-enters the same false-positive alert path the PR was originally written to fix (Auto-answer parser failed / No Q-ID blocks detected). The fix is also asymmetric with the plan.yml Perl regexes at lines 1210-1212, which correctly carry `^\s*(?:>\s*)*` and therefore handle the same indented-blockquoted input. This makes the regression both a runtime defect and a divergence from the documented intent of the follow-up commit.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
